model.algorithm: Calibrated FashionCLIP retrieval + scikit-learn Ridge sales forecast + inventory policy
model.orderPolicy: Expected sales divided by target sell-through
model.evaluation: Leave-one-out validation; temporal holdout requires at least three clean seasons
model.interval: Finite-sample 80% conformal interval for expected sales from out-of-fold residuals

visionCalibration.method: Robust logistic calibration of FashionCLIP cosine distance

activeAttributes.label: Category / item type
activeAttributes.method: Exact match with a strong cross-category penalty

activeAttributes.label: Lifecycle family
activeAttributes.method: Normalized AW, SS, or CORE family match

excludedConstants.label: Range code
excludedConstants.reason: Constant after normalization: CMI + VMI and VMI + CMI are the same range.

excludedConstants.label: Merch type
excludedConstants.reason: All historical candidates are FASHION, so this field cannot rank one analogue above another.

excludedNonComparisonFields.label: Identifiers
excludedNonComparisonFields.reason: Row and style identifiers identify products; they are not reusable product characteristics.

excludedNonComparisonFields.label: Colour variant code
excludedNonComparisonFields.reason: Variant codes such as 1001 are not stable colour meanings; colour names are compared instead.

excludedNonComparisonFields.label: Historical season label
excludedNonComparisonFields.reason: There is no upcoming counterpart; the comparable CAT6 lifecycle family is used instead.

excludedNonComparisonFields.label: Demand outcomes
excludedNonComparisonFields.reason: These fields train and validate the quantity forecast; using them in product similarity would leak outcomes.

attributeAudit.policy: Only comparable fields with at least two populated historical values can contribute to similarity.
